name: Opik
description: Comet's open-source LLM observability, evaluation and agent tracing platform.
descriptionZh: Comet 出品的开源 LLM 可观测、评测与 Agent 追踪平台。
keyFact: Opik is Comet's Apache-2.0 open-source platform for LLM observability, evaluation and agent tracing; its README reported 20,000+ GitHub stars as of mid-2026.
keyFactZh: Opik 是 Comet 以 Apache-2.0 开源的 LLM 可观测、评测与 Agent 追踪平台；其 README 在 2026 年中报告了 20,000+ GitHub 星标。
caveat: Star counts differ by source: Comet's landing page showed ~15.6k while the README and third parties reported 20k-21.8k.
caveatZh: 星标口径不一：Comet 官网落地页显示约 15.6k，而 README 与第三方记录为 20k-21.8k。
